dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "8. In non-emergency situations, please follow the ground guides, keep to fixed flight paths, and take off and landings at safe speeds. Dangerous actions are strictly prohibited."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Note: 'The Saurian did it' shall not be considered an acceptable excuse. Qucusaurs have an innate capacity for safe flight, but humans do not."
